subject: computer-science

items.q: Is content on the internet free to copy and reuse?
items.correct: No — most is protected by copyright; reuse usually needs permission.
items.misconception: Yes, anything online is free to use.
items.why: Copyright protects creators' work; you generally need a licence or permission to reuse it.

items.q: What does the Data Protection Act / GDPR require?
items.correct: Personal data is handled fairly, kept secure and used only for stated purposes.
items.misconception: Companies can use personal data however they like.
items.random_wrong: All data must be made public.
items.why: Data protection law gives individuals rights over their personal data and obliges organisations to protect it.

specSource: AQA GCSE Computer Science (8525) specification; Ethical Legal & Environmental Impacts
